title: TelemetryFeatureVector_v2
description: Production network feature schema extracted from Zeek and Suricata telemetry.

features.name: packet_rate
features.meaning: Packets transmitted per second in active flow window
features.threat_relevance: Massive packet spikes signify volumetric DDoS floods.

features.name: byte_rate
features.meaning: Bytes transmitted per second in active flow window
features.threat_relevance: High bandwidth consumption indicates pipe-saturating flood attacks.

features.name: syn_rate
features.meaning: Initial SYN attempt rate per second
features.threat_relevance: High SYN rates mark aggressive SYN flood attacks.

features.name: syn_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of SYN packets to total flow packets
features.threat_relevance: Approaches 1.0 during unidirectional SYN flood attacks.

features.name: ack_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of ACK packets to total flow packets
features.threat_relevance: Low in SYN floods; elevated in ACK reflection attacks.

features.name: rst_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of RST packets to total flow packets
features.threat_relevance: Elevated in scanner teardowns and connection termination storms.

features.name: udp_rate
features.meaning: UDP packet transmission rate per second
features.calculation: udp_pkts / max(1e-3, duration) if protocol == 'UDP' else 0.0
features.threat_relevance: Surges indicate UDP reflection/amplification floods (NTP, DNS, CLDAP).

features.name: unique_src_count
features.meaning: Unique source IPs contacting target destination in window
features.threat_relevance: Distinguishes single-source floods from distributed botnet attacks.

features.name: src_ip_entropy
features.meaning: Shannon entropy of source IPs targeting destination
features.threat_relevance: High entropy signifies heavily distributed spoofed-source DDoS.

features.name: dest_concentration
features.meaning: Fraction of all network packets directed at this single destination
features.threat_relevance: High concentration reveals targeted victim host under heavy flood.

features.name: byte_amplification_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of response bytes to origin request bytes
features.threat_relevance: Values >> 10 signify active UDP reflection/amplification.

features.name: iat_min
features.meaning: Minimum inter-arrival time between consecutive connections
features.threat_relevance: Identifies rigid timing floors in botnet polling intervals.

features.name: iat_max
features.meaning: Maximum inter-arrival time between consecutive connections
features.threat_relevance: Assesses upper bound of sleep/wake cycles.

features.name: iat_mean
features.meaning: Mean packet/connection inter-arrival time in seconds
features.threat_relevance: Establishes base heartbeat interval of malware beaconing.

features.name: iat_std
features.meaning: Standard deviation of inter-arrival times
features.threat_relevance: Ultra-low variance indicates non-human automated heartbeat.

features.name: iat_cv
features.meaning: Coefficient of Variation of IAT (Jitter Metric)
features.threat_relevance: Values < 0.15 strongly signify rigid C2 framework beaconing.

features.name: periodicity_score
features.meaning: Dominant FFT spectral power peak fraction
features.threat_relevance: Detects periodic beaconing even when jitter is added.

features.name: repeated_dst_freq
features.meaning: Connection frequency to this specific external endpoint per minute
features.threat_relevance: Repeated persistent check-ins to identical C2 servers.

features.name: flow_duration
features.meaning: Total active duration of the connection in seconds
features.threat_relevance: Short, recurring bursts characterize classic HTTP/TLS beacons.

features.name: repeated_conn_count
features.meaning: Total number of discrete connection sessions established to same endpoint
features.threat_relevance: High session repetition without user interaction indicates malware.

features.name: query_len_mean
features.meaning: Average character length of requested DNS domain names
features.threat_relevance: Significantly elevated in DNS data exfiltration tunnels.

features.name: shannon_entropy_mean
features.meaning: Average Shannon character entropy of requested domain names
features.threat_relevance: Values > 3.8 reveal pseudo-random algorithmic DGAs.

features.name: vowel_ratio
features.meaning: Proportion of vowel characters (a,e,i,o,u) in domain name
features.threat_relevance: Abnormal vowel density flags non-natural algorithmic domain names.

features.name: consonant_ratio
features.meaning: Proportion of consonant characters in domain name
features.threat_relevance: Heavy consonant clustering is a classic signature of DGAs.

features.name: digit_ratio
features.meaning: Proportion of numerical digits in domain name
features.threat_relevance: Hex/Base32 encoded subdomains exhibit heavy digit counts.

features.name: unique_char_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of unique characters to total domain length
features.threat_relevance: High uniqueness indicates random high-entropy strings.

features.name: subdomain_depth_mean
features.meaning: Average number of subdomain labels in DNS query
features.threat_relevance: DNS tunnelling uses deep nested subdomains for data chunks.

features.name: query_frequency
features.meaning: DNS queries per second from source host
features.threat_relevance: Rapid query bursts indicate automated DGA resolution sweeps.

features.name: txt_record_ratio
features.meaning: Proportion of DNS queries requesting TXT or NULL records
features.threat_relevance: Heavy TXT querying signifies DNS tunnel command & exfil channels.

features.name: ngram_log_likelihood
features.meaning: Bi-gram log-likelihood score against baseline English language corpus
features.threat_relevance: Low scores identify unpronounceable algorithmic domains.

features.name: tls_version_num
features.meaning: Numeric encoding of negotiated TLS version (e.g. 1.2, 1.3, 0.0 if missing)
features.calculation: 1.3 if TLSv1.3 else (1.2 if TLSv1.2 else 0.0)
features.threat_relevance: Identifies legacy or anomalous TLS versions.

features.name: has_tls_sni
features.meaning: Binary indicator for presence of Server Name Indication in ClientHello
features.threat_relevance: Direct IP connection without SNI on 443 often marks raw malware C2.

features.name: ja3_present
features.meaning: Binary indicator of whether client JA3 fingerprint is available
features.calculation: 1.0 if ja3 is not None else 0.0
features.threat_relevance: Presence enables client TLS stack behavioral identification.

features.name: pkt_size_mean
features.meaning: Mean packet wire size in bytes across flow
features.threat_relevance: Characterizes payload footprint across protocols.

features.name: pkt_size_std
features.meaning: Standard deviation of packet sizes
features.threat_relevance: Distinguishes uniform keepalive beacons from rich interactive sessions.

features.name: pkt_size_entropy
features.meaning: Shannon entropy of packet size distribution (SPLT)
features.threat_relevance: Captures structural behavioral variance in encrypted sessions.

features.name: directionality_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of origin (outbound) packets to total session packets
features.threat_relevance: Reveals unidirectional command pipelines vs interactive sessions.

features.name: unique_dst_ports
features.meaning: Count of distinct destination ports targeted by source IP
features.threat_relevance: Direct indicator of vertical port scanning.

features.name: unique_dst_hosts
features.meaning: Count of distinct destination IP hosts targeted by source IP
features.threat_relevance: Direct indicator of horizontal subnet sweep / reconnaissance.

features.name: dst_port_fanout
features.meaning: Rate of unique destination ports contacted per second
features.threat_relevance: Identifies high-speed automated scanning tools (Nmap/Masscan).

features.name: dst_host_fanout
features.meaning: Rate of unique destination hosts contacted per second
features.threat_relevance: Measures horizontal worm spreading or reconnaissance velocity.

features.name: conn_attempts
features.meaning: Total connection attempts initiated by source host in window
features.threat_relevance: High volumes indicate aggressive brute-force probing.

features.name: conn_attempt_rate
features.meaning: Connection attempts initiated per second by source host
features.threat_relevance: Quantifies scanner aggression and throughput.

features.name: failed_conn_ratio
features.meaning: Proportion of connections with unestablished states (S0, REJ, RSTO)
features.threat_relevance: Port scans yield high failure rates on closed/filtered ports.

features.name: inbound_bytes
features.meaning: Total inbound (server-to-client) bytes received in flow
features.threat_relevance: Baseline for bidirectional volume ratio calculation.

features.name: outbound_bytes
features.meaning: Total outbound (client-to-server) bytes transmitted in flow
features.threat_relevance: Surges flag massive unauthorized data transfer.

features.name: out_in_byte_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of outbound bytes to inbound bytes
features.threat_relevance: Values >> 1.0 reveal asymmetric upload/exfiltration behavior.

features.name: bytes_per_flow
features.meaning: Average total bytes per connection session between endpoints
features.threat_relevance: Distinguishes tiny heartbeat sessions from bulky file transfers.

features.name: outbound_rate
features.meaning: Outbound byte transfer rate in bytes per second
features.threat_relevance: High upload throughput signifies active file exfiltration.

features.name: asymmetric_traffic_score
features.meaning: Normalized flow volume asymmetry index between -1.0 and +1.0
features.threat_relevance: +1.0 indicates pure outbound exfiltration; -1.0 indicates pure download.

features.name: src_out_degree
features.meaning: Graph out-degree: number of unique target IPs contacted by source
features.threat_relevance: High out-degree flags scanners, worms, and lateral movement.

features.name: dst_in_degree
features.meaning: Graph in-degree: number of unique source IPs contacting destination
features.threat_relevance: Surges mark DDoS attack targets or central enterprise servers.

features.name: comm_partner_count
features.meaning: Total unique bipartite communication partners for this endpoint
features.threat_relevance: Broad partner fan-out signifies automated discovery activity.

features.name: graph_fanout_ratio
features.meaning: Ratio of distinct targets to total connection edges
features.threat_relevance: Approaches 1.0 during rapid 1-packet-per-host reconnaissance.
